Professor Hu Jilin has been awarded the 2023 ACM SIGSPATIAL China Rising Star Award. Combining big data technology with artificial intelligence methods, Professor Hu Jilin conducts in-depth research in spatiotemporal data management, big data management, and analysis. He has proposed a series of new theories, technologies, and methods, contributing to the advancement of digital cities and intelligent transportation.
